title: A Day at the Park
text:
Ali and Zeynep are in a park. Ali has a red ball. Zeynep says, 'Can I play?' Ali says, 'Yes!'

They play together for a long time. Zeynep throws the ball, and Ali catches it. 'Good job!' says Zeynep. They both laugh.

questions.text: What does Zeynep say after Ali catches the ball?
How do Ali and Zeynep feel at the end of the story?
Why does Zeynep ask 'Can I play?'
options: She wants to join the game
She is looking for her bag

vocabulary.definition: a public place with grass and trees where people can play
a round object that you throw, kick or catch
takes hold of something that is moving through the air
to make sounds with your voice because something is funny

paragraph_translations: Ali ve Zeynep bir parktalar. Ali'nin kırmızı bir topu var. Zeynep, 'Oynayabilir miyim?' diye soruyor. Ali, 'Evet!' diyor.
Uzun bir süre birlikte oynuyorlar. Zeynep topu atar ve Ali onu yakalar. Zeynep, 'Aferin!' diyor. İkisi de gülüyor.
